rounds.title_zh: 汽车镀铬窗框与机械倒角不再像碎玻璃闪烁：Kaplanyan 屏幕空间法线曲率几何高光抗锯齿选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Curved chrome bevels without sub-pixel sparkle strobing: Kaplanyan screen-space geometric specular AA selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在光滑金属倒角（本征粗糙度 α₀=0.05，单像素几何法线曲率 κ=0.35 rad/px）跨越 17 个亚像素位移站（δ ∈ [−0.40, +0.40] px）时，朴素未滤波原始粗糙度在第 8 站（δ=0.00 px）暴冲至 7.9788（7.07× 能量过冲），并在 δ=±0.40 px 跌至 0.1583，产生 50.40× 帧间频闪（污染全部 17/17 站）。
采用 Kaplanyan & Antonov (HPG 2016) 屏幕空间几何法线方差滤波 α_AA = √(α₀² + κ²) = 0.3536，在第 8 站锁死像素积分守恒亮度 1.1284，全 17 站峰谷频闪比仅 1.08×（0/17 爆闪站）。
58 实体 17 站点倒角测角光度计台对比闭式曲率方差滤波与 64 点亚像素法线分布数值卷积基线（8192 次 1.25 ms vs 199.69 ms，提速 159.86×，误差 6.66e-16），不冒充神经视频超分。
conclusions_en: Across 17 sub-pixel camera drift stations (δ ∈ [−0.40, +0.40] px) on a glossy curved bevel (base roughness α₀=0.05, pixel normal curvature κ=0.35 rad/px), naive unfiltered raw roughness spikes to 7.9788 at δ=0.00 px (7.07× blowout) and drops to 0.1583 at δ=±0.40 px, causing a 50.40× sub-pixel sparkle strobe across 17/17 stations.

Kaplanyan & Antonov (HPG 2016) screen-space geometric normal-variance filtering widens roughness to α_AA = √(α₀² + κ²) = 0.3536, locking δ=0.00 px at pixel-conserved 1.1284 with a calm 1.08× envelope (0/17 firefly stations).

The 58-solid 17-station bevel goniophotometer bench compares closed-form variance widening against 64-tap sub-pixel normal convolution quadrature (1.25 ms vs 199.69 ms at 8,192 passes, 159.86× speedup, 6.66e-16 error) without claiming neural super-resolution.

rounds.title_zh: 不等距运镜关键帧不再原地倒车打八字结：Yuksel 向心 Catmull-Rom 样条（α=0.5）选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Camera splines without figure-8 self-intersection loops: Yuksel centripetal Catmull-Rom (α=0.5) selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在两侧 16.12 m 长助跑夹着中间 2.00 m 短桥段（长短弦比 8.06:1）的不等距关键帧上，朴素均匀 Catmull-Rom（α=0.0）在中点第 8 站（u=0.50）向上暴冲至 y=1.0000 m（5.45× 过冲，+0.8165 m 膨胀），并在第 6~10 站发生 dx/du=−1.0000 m/u 倒车逆行自交环（污染 15/17 站）。
采用 Yuksel, Schaefer & Keyser (CAD 2011) 向心节点参数化 Δt_k = ∥P_{k+1}−P_k∥^0.5（α=0.5），将中点拱高收敛在 y=0.1835 m，全 17 站前进速度 dx/du ≥ +1.6184 m/u > 0（0/17 倒车自交环，0 尖点）。
58 实体 17 站点样条张力计台对比预计算向心 Horner 三次多项式与 3 层 Barry-Goldman 递推金字塔基线（8192 次 1.81 ms vs 75.76 ms，提速 41.96×，误差 6.66e-16），不冒充神经轨迹扩散。
conclusions_en: On a 2.00 m short bridge span flanked by 16.12 m approach chords (8.06:1 chord ratio), naive uniform Catmull-Rom (α=0.0) balloons midpoint u=0.50 to y=1.0000 m (5.45× overshoot) and reverses backward at dx/du=−1.0000 m/u across 5 retrograde stations to form a figure-8 self-intersection loop (corrupting 15/17 stations).

Yuksel, Schaefer & Keyser (CAD 2011) centripetal parameterization Δt_k = ∥P_{k+1}−P_k∥^0.5 (α=0.5) bounds midpoint arch height at y=0.1835 m with strictly positive forward velocity dx/du ≥ +1.6184 m/u > 0 across all 17 stations (0 loops, 0 cusps).

The 58-solid 17-station spline tensiometer bench compares precomputed Horner cubic evaluation against 3-level recursive Barry-Goldman knot pyramids (1.81 ms vs 75.76 ms at 8,192 passes, 41.96× speedup, 6.66e-16 error) without claiming neural trajectory diffusion.

rounds.title_zh: 黄昏落日地平线不再塌陷成死黑断层带：Hillaire 球壳大气光学质量求交选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Sunset horizons without flat-earth secant blackouts: Hillaire spherical-shell atmosphere airmass selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在地球半径 R_p=6360 km、大气标高 H=8.0 km（曲率比 q=795.0）、红光天顶光学厚度 τ_R=0.04 的掠射落日区（θ ∈ [74°, 90°]），朴素平地球正割近似 1/cos θ 在 90° 地平线发散至 +∞，将红光透射率从 0.2028 压死至 0.0000（在 89° 峰值损失 −0.2206，污染 9/17 站）。
采用 Bruneton (2008) & Hillaire (EGSR 2020) 闭式球壳求交 m_sph(μ) = √(q²μ²+2q+1)−qμ，在 90° 地平线锁定有限大气质量 √1591 = 39.8873 倍，完整保留 T_red = 0.2028 绯红落日余晖（0/17 死黑站）。
58 实体 17 站点直接日射表台对比闭式球壳求交与 64 步三维球壳光线步进积分基线（8192 次 4.50 ms vs 254.68 ms，提速 56.65×，误差 2.24e-14），不冒充神经天空补全。
conclusions_en: Across 17 grazing sunset zenith angles (θ ∈ [74°, 90°]) with planet radius R_p=6360 km, scale height H=8.0 km (q=795.0), and red optical depth τ_R=0.04, naive flat-earth planar secant 1/cos θ diverges to +∞ at θ=90°, crushing horizon transmittance from 0.2028 down to 0.0000 (−0.2206 peak loss at 89°, corrupting 9/17 stations).

Bruneton (2008) & Hillaire (EGSR 2020) closed-form spherical-shell ray intersection m_sph(μ) = √(q²μ²+2q+1)−qμ bounds the 90° horizon path to √1591 = 39.8873 airmasses, preserving T_red = 0.2028 crimson sunset glow (0/17 blackout stations).

The 58-solid 17-station sunset pyrheliometer bench compares closed-form spherical chord intersection against 64-step 3D spherical-shell ray marching (4.50 ms vs 254.68 ms at 8,192 passes, 56.65× speedup, 2.24e-14 error) without claiming neural sky inpainting.

rounds.title_zh: 半分辨率体积雾与神圣光不再给暗色角色裹上发光白圈：Kopf 联合双边高分深度引导上采样选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Half-resolution volumetrics without glowing silhouette halos: Kopf joint bilateral depth upsampling selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在近景暗色立柱（z_fg=2.0 m, L_fg=0.0500）与远景亮色体积雾（z_bg=25.0 m, L_bg=0.9500）交界的第 8 站前景边缘（u=0.50），朴素硬件双线性上采样混入 50% 背景亮雾输出 0.5000（产生 +0.4500 即 10.00× 发光白圈，污染 7/17 个边界站点）。
采用 Kopf 等人 (SIGGRAPH 2007) 联合双边深度引导上采样 w_k = w_spatial(u)·exp(−Δz_k²/2σ_z²)，将跨 23 m 深度断崖的异侧采样权重压零，在第 8 站严格锁定 0.0500 并在第 9 站跃迁至 0.9500（0/17 光晕渗漏）。
58 实体 17 站点双边密度计台对比半分辨率 2 抽头联合双边上采样与全分辨率 64 步体积步进基线（8192 次 1.13 ms vs 10.71 ms，提速 9.50×，误差 2.48e-15），不冒充神经深度补全。
conclusions_en: At foreground silhouette edge station 8 (u=0.50, z_hi=2.0 m, L_fg=0.0500) in front of bright background fog (z_bg=25.0 m, L_bg=0.9500), naive hardware bilinear upsampling blends 50% of the background fog to output 0.5000 (+0.4500 / 10.00× glowing halo bleed across 7/17 boundary stations).

Kopf et al. (SIGGRAPH 2007) Joint Bilateral Upsampling weights half-res taps by full-res depth affinity exp(−Δz_k²/2σ_z²), locking station 8 at 0.0500 and station 9 at 0.9500 with 0/17 halo bleed stations.

The 58-solid 17-station bilateral densitometer bench compares half-resolution 2-tap Joint Bilateral Upsampling against full-resolution 64-step volumetric ray marching (1.13 ms vs 10.71 ms at 8,192 passes, 9.50× speedup, 2.48e-15 error) without claiming neural depth inpainting.

rounds.title_zh: 角色鼻孔与装甲深缝不再泛出放射性蓝天高光：Lagarde Frostbite 视角粗糙度耦合高光遮蔽选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Dark crevices without glowing sky reflections: Lagarde Frostbite view-roughness specular occlusion selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在深腔环境遮蔽 AO=0.25、粗糙度 r=0.25 的 17 个视角余弦站点（N·V ∈ [0.05, 0.85]）上，朴素未遮蔽 IBL 高光恒定输出 SO=1.0000，在第 0 站掠射角（N·V=0.05）产生 +0.7869（4.69× 过冲）的深腔蓝天反光泄漏（污染全部 17/17 站）。
采用 Lagarde & de Rousiers (SIGGRAPH 2014 Frostbite) 视角粗糙度耦合公式 SO = clamp((N·V+AO)^exp2(−16r−1)−1+AO, 0, 1)，在第 0 站掠射角收紧至 SO=0.2131（0/17 漏光站）。
58 实体 17 站点深腔反射计台对比闭式 Lagarde 高光遮蔽与 64 步可见锥幂积分基线（8192 次 2.10 ms vs 8.92 ms，提速 4.24×，误差 6.22e-15），不冒充神经环境光遮蔽。
conclusions_en: Inside a recessed cavity (AO=0.25, roughness r=0.25) across 17 viewing cosine stations (N·V ∈ [0.05, 0.85]), naive unoccluded IBL specular outputs SO=1.0000 everywhere, leaking +0.7869 (4.69× blowout) at grazing station 0 (N·V=0.05) across all 17/17 stations.
Lagarde & de Rousiers (SIGGRAPH 2014 Frostbite) view-roughness Specular Occlusion SO = clamp((N·V+AO)^exp2(−16r−1)−1+AO, 0, 1) clamps grazing station 0 to SO=0.2131 with 0/17 leaking stations.

The 58-solid 17-station cavity reflectometer bench compares closed-form Lagarde Specular Occlusion against 64-step visibility-cone quadrature (2.10 ms vs 8.92 ms at 8,192 passes, 4.24× speedup, 6.22e-15 error) without claiming neural ambient occlusion.

rounds.title_zh: 隔着门缝与铁栅栏看人不再整块凭空消失：Greene 保守最远深度 Hi-Z 金字塔选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Doorway occlusion culling without mesh popping: Greene conservative farthest-depth Hi-Z pyramid selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在含 60 个近墙像素（z_wall=4.0 m）与 4 个远景门缝像素（z_gap=50.0 m）的 8×8（Mip 3）深度图块上，朴素均值深度 Mip 将遮挡阈值拉低至 z_avg=6.8750 m，导致门缝后方 z_obj ∈ [8.5, 46.0] m 处本该清晰可见的 16/17（94.12%）个物体被错误剔除消失。
采用 Greene 等人 (SIGGRAPH 1993) 保守最远深度归约 z_HiZ = max(4.0, 50.0) = 50.0000 m，100% 保留门缝后方全部 17/17 个可见物体（0 误剔除闪崩）。
58 实体 17 站点遮挡准直仪台对比单次 O(1) 保守 Hi-Z Mip 查表与 64 像素全分扫描基线（8192 次 0.42 ms vs 12.52 ms，提速 29.76×，0 误差），不冒充神经可见性预测。
conclusions_en: Across an 8×8 (Mip-3) tile containing 60 wall pixels (z_wall=4.0 m) and 4 doorway-slit pixels (z_gap=50.0 m), naive box-average depth mipmapping lowers the occlusion threshold to z_avg=6.8750 m, falsely culling 16/17 (94.12%) visible objects standing behind the doorway at z_obj ∈ [8.5, 46.0] m.
Greene et al. (SIGGRAPH 1993) conservative farthest-depth reduction z_HiZ = max(4.0, 50.0) = 50.0000 m retains all 17/17 visible doorway objects with 0 false occlusion popping.

The 58-solid 17-station occlusion collimator bench compares O(1) Hi-Z Mip-3 lookup against brute-force 64-pixel full-resolution tile scanning (0.42 ms vs 12.52 ms at 8,192 passes, 29.76× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural visibility prediction.

rounds.title_zh: 站在河谷晨雾里抬头看山不再糊成死白雾墙：Wenzel 闭式指数高度雾线积分选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Mountain peaks above valley mist without whiteout walls: Wenzel closed-form exponential height-fog integral selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 当摄像机位于河谷低地（h_cam=0 m, σ₀=0.015 m⁻¹, k=0.02 m⁻¹）仰望 L=200 m 外第 16 站山巅（h=240 m）时，朴素相机高度密度外推恒算 τ=3.0000，将山巅压死在 T_naive=0.0498（丢失 −0.4882 可见度，污染 16/17 个高海拔站点）。
采用 Wenzel (SIGGRAPH 2006) 闭式指数高度雾线积分 τ(Δh) = σ₀·L·(1−e^(−kΔh))/(kΔh)，在第 16 站山巅将光学厚度收敛至 0.6199，保留 T_fog=0.5380 通透山脊（清晰 10.81×，0/17 白化站）。
58 实体 17 站点山体透射计台对比闭式线积分原函数与 64 步比尔-朗伯级联步进基线（8192 次 3.90 ms vs 13.64 ms，提速 3.50×，误差 1.55e-15），不冒充神经图像去雾。
conclusions_en: When looking 200 m up from a misty valley floor (h_cam=0 m, σ₀=0.015 m⁻¹, k=0.02 m⁻¹) toward a h=240 m mountain peak, naive camera-altitude density extrapolation computes constant τ=3.0000 and buries the peak at T_naive=0.0498 (−0.4882 whiteout loss across 16/17 elevated stations).

Wenzel (SIGGRAPH 2006) closed-form exponential height-fog line integration τ(Δh) = σ₀·L·(1−e^(−kΔh))/(kΔh) reduces optical depth at h=240 m to 0.6199, preserving T_fog=0.5380 clear mountain visibility (10.81× clearer, 0/17 whiteout stations).

The 58-solid 17-station mountain transmissometer bench compares closed-form antiderivative evaluation against 64-step Beer-Lambert ray-marching cascade (3.90 ms vs 13.64 ms at 8,192 passes, 3.50× speedup, 1.55e-15 error) without claiming neural image dehazing.

rounds.title_zh: 拉高积雨云逆光银边不再把整朵云炸成死白：Henyey-Greenstein (1−g²) 能量守恒云雾相函数选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Cloud silver-linings without multi-scattering blowout: Henyey-Greenstein (1−g²) phase normalization selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 g ∈ [0.05, 0.85] 的 17 个散射各向异性站点上，漏掉 (1−g²) 分子的朴素前向波瓣使球面总散射能量按 1/(1−g²) 膨胀，在第 15 站（g=0.80）达 2.7778×，在第 16 站（g=0.85）暴冲至 3.6036×（污染全部 17/17 站，引爆多重散射云团过曝）。
采用 Henyey & Greenstein (1941) 归一化相函数 Φ_HG(μ, g) = (1−g²)/(1+g²−2gμ)^(3/2)，在塑造 45.00× 逆光银边峰值的同时，在全 17 站严格锁死 E_sphere = 1.0000（0 能量违背）。
58 实体 17 站点云雾浊度计台对比闭式归一化原函数与 64 子区间球面求积基线（8192 次 0.35 ms vs 9.04 ms，提速 26.19×，误差 1.11e-15），不冒充神经云层重打光。
conclusions_en: Across 17 scattering anisotropy stations (g ∈ [0.05, 0.85]), omitting the (1−g²) numerator causes spherical scattered energy to explode as 1/(1−g²), reaching 2.7778× at g=0.80 and 3.6036× at g=0.85 across all 17/17 stations.

Henyey & Greenstein (1941) phase normalization Φ_HG(μ, g) = (1−g²)/(1+g²−2gμ)^(3/2) preserves a 45.00× forward silver-lining peak at g=0.80 while locking spherical energy at E_sphere = 1.0000 across all 17 stations (0 violations).

The 58-solid 17-station cloud nephelometer bench compares closed-form normalized evaluation against 64-subinterval spherical quadrature (0.35 ms vs 9.04 ms at 8,192 passes, 26.19× speedup, 1.11e-15 error) without claiming neural cloud relighting.

rounds.title_zh: TAA 运镜不再像涂了一层凡士林迅速变糊：Sigg-Jiménez 硬件双线性合并双三次重采样选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: TAA history reprojection without Vaseline blur: Sigg-Jiménez hardware-bilinear bicubic resampling selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在纹理波峰曲率 κ=0.16、连续 K=8 帧递归 TAA 历史重采样的 17 个亚纹素站点上，朴素单抽头硬件双线性插值在中点第 8 站（u=0.50）按 0.96⁸=0.7214 指数衰减，丢失 −0.2786（27.86%）的高频峰值锐度（污染 15/17 个非整数站点）。
采用 Sigg & Hadwiger (2005) / Jiménez (2016) 硬件双线性权重合并恒等式 s₁₂ = w₂/(w₁+w₂)，在 8 帧递归后严格锁死波峰锐度 C_hist = 1.0000（0/17 模糊站）。
58 实体 17 站点历史显微密度计台对比硬件双线性合并双三次与 16 抽头张量积双三次求值基线（8192 次 2.76 ms vs 10.19 ms，提速 3.69×，误差 4.44e-15），不冒充神经超分重建。
conclusions_en: Over K=8 recursive TAA history reprojection frames on a parabolic texture crest (κ=0.16), naive 1-tap bilinear interpolation erodes midpoint u=0.50 from 1.0000 down to 0.96⁸ = 0.7214 (−27.86% Vaseline blur loss across 15/17 interior sub-texel stations).
Sigg & Hadwiger (2005) / Jiménez (2016) hardware-bilinear weight merging s₁₂ = w₂/(w₁+w₂) preserves exact C_hist = 1.0000 across all 8 recursive frames (0/17 blurred stations).

The 58-solid 17-station history microdensitometer bench compares bilinear-merged bicubic evaluation against 16-tap (4×4) tensor-product bicubic evaluation (2.76 ms vs 10.19 ms at 8,192 passes, 3.69× speedup, 4.44e-15 error) without claiming neural frame upscaling.

rounds.title_zh: 电影级镜头色差不再裂成红绿蓝三条假鬼影：连续光谱查找表色散积分选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Radial chromatic aberration without 3-tap RGB ghosting: continuous spectral-LUT dispersion selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在半宽 w=1.5 px 的细高光被径向色散拉开 Δr=12.0 px 的 17 个径向站点上，朴素 3 抽头 RGB 通道分离仅采样 −6 px、0 px、+6 px，导致 x=±2, ±3, ±4 px 共 6/17 个中间光谱站跌入 0.0000 死黑断层，将单条高光撕裂成 3 个孤立原色重影（污染 15/17 站）。
采用 Playdead INSIDE / Guertin (2014) 连续光谱色散积分，在第 5 站（x=−3 px）及中心 9 站精确锁定平坦彩虹平台 L_disp = w/Δr = 0.1250（0/17 断层漏检）。
58 实体 17 站点摄谱仪台对比闭式连续光谱重叠原函数与 64 步波长数值求积基线（8192 次 0.79 ms vs 10.48 ms，提速 13.20×，误差 1.39e-17），不冒充神经镜头仿真。
conclusions_en: When a w=1.5 px highlight is radially dispersed across Δr=12.0 px, naive 3-tap RGB channel splitting samples only x=−6, 0, +6 px, dropping 6/17 intermediate stations (x=±2, ±3, ±4 px) to 0.0000 dead-black gaps and splitting the highlight into 3 disconnected RGB ghosts across 15/17 stations.
Continuous spectral-LUT dispersion integration preserves a seamless trapezoidal rainbow plateau of L_disp = w/Δr = 0.1250 across x ∈ [−4, +4] px with 0/17 gap dropouts.

The 58-solid 17-station spectrograph bench compares closed-form spectral overlap integration against 64-tap wavelength quadrature (0.79 ms vs 10.48 ms at 8,192 passes, 13.20× speedup, 1.39e-17 error) without claiming neural lens simulation.

rounds.title_zh: 墙角与衣褶不再像抹了一层黑炭灰：Jiménez GTAO 朗伯余弦加权地平线积分选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Ambient occlusion without sooty gray crevices: Jiménez GTAO cosine-weighted horizon integral selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 γ ∈ [5°, 85°] 的 17 个天空孔径站点上，无权重立体角 SSAO（1−cos γ）因忽略朗伯余弦定律 cos θ，在第 8 站直角墙角（γ=45°）将可见度从 0.5000 错误压暗至 0.2929（丢失 −0.2071 即相对压暗 −41.42%，60° 峰值丢失 −0.2500，污染全部 17/17 站）。
采用 Jiménez 等人 (SIGGRAPH 2016) GTAO 闭式余弦加权原函数 V_GTAO(γ) = ½(1−cos 2γ) = sin²γ，在 45° 处精确锁定 AO = 0.5000（与路径追踪真值 100% 吻合，0/17 脏黑站）。
58 实体 17 站点日晷仪台对比闭式 GTAO 余弦原函数与 64 环半球数值求积基线（8192 次 2.00 ms vs 91.32 ms，提速 45.61×，误差 1.44e-15），不冒充神经环境光遮蔽。
conclusions_en: Across 17 open-sky cone half-angle stations (γ ∈ [5°, 85°]), naive unweighted solid-angle SSAO (1−cos γ) ignores Lambert's cos θ law, over-darkening a 45° corner from 0.5000 down to 0.2929 (−0.2071 / −41.42% relative error, −0.2500 max loss at 60° across all 17/17 stations).
Jiménez et al. (SIGGRAPH 2016) GTAO cosine-weighted horizon integration V_GTAO(γ) = ½(1−cos 2γ) = sin²γ locks γ=45° at exact path-traced AO = 0.5000 (0/17 muddy stations).

rounds.title_zh: 法线贴图毛孔与铆钉在斜射阳光下不再变平：Chan 孔径微阴影门控选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 屏幕空间反射光线不再向深处弯曲穿墙：McGuire 齐次倒数深度 2D DDA 选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 实时阴影不再陷入墙面摩尔纹与脚底悬空两难：Gruen 正弦法向偏移偏置选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 距离场阴影只需 1 条射线即可零噪点柔和散开：Quilez-Wright 单射线 SDF 锥比软阴影选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 全局光照去噪不再把 90° 墙角涂成脏黑圆角：交叉双边法线截断门控选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 广角镜头暗角不再把四角掐成死黑窥孔：Born-Wolf 物理余弦四次方自然渐晕选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 低模平滑圆柱与脸颊开启 AO 不再爆出多边形黑棱线：Bavoil HBAO 切角偏置选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 随机六边形防重复贴图不再在交界处糊成泥斑：Heitz-Neyret 保方差归一化选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 角色五角星点与多边奇异点切换细分不再鼓包跳变：Halstead Catmull-Clark 极限模板选型 FAQ

58 实体 17 站点丝绒绒毛角光度计台对比免三角代数式与 64 方位角竖直纤维柱面散射积分基线（8192 次 0.45 ms vs 115.23 ms，提速 258.13×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经织物生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 half-angle stations (θ_h ∈ [0°, 80°] with α=0.50), a naive surface cosine lobe cos^(1/α) θ_h inverts upright fiber scattering: creating a +1.0000 plastic blob at 0° and starving station 12 (60°) to 0.2500 (−0.5000 / −66.67% deficit across 16/17 stations).
Estevez & Kulla (SIGGRAPH 2017 / glTF KHR_materials_sheen) Charlie sin-power NDF I_Charlie = (1−(N·H)²)^(1/(2α)) locks 0° at 0.0000, 60° at 0.7500, and 80° at 0.9698 with 0/17 corrupted stations.

The 58-solid 17-station velvet goniophotometer bench compares trig-free algebraic evaluation against 64-azimuthal cylindrical fiber quadrature (0.45 ms vs 115.23 ms at 8,192 passes, 258.13× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural cloth synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 真人秀发不再像单条塑料尼龙假发：Marschner 毛鳞片双高光天使环选型 FAQ

conclusions_en: Across 17 longitudinal half-angle stations (θ_h ∈ [−16.0°, +16.0°] with cuticle tilt α_c=+3.0°), naive Kajiya-Kay single-lobe shading locks onto 0.0° (1.0000), dropping station 5 (−6.0°) to 0.0561 and collapsing station 12 (+8.0° TRT peak) to 0.0060 (−0.7940 / −99.25% loss across 15/17 stations).

rounds.title_zh: 开放世界公路上不再平推刺眼的级联阴影分割线：CSM 三阶埃尔米特抖动过渡选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 汽车金属漆与钢琴烤漆掠射角不再泛死白光晕：Weidlich-Wilkie 清漆透射耦合选型 FAQ

conclusions_en: Across 17 incident viewing angle stations (θ_i ∈ [0°, 80°] with n_coat=1.50, F0=0.0400, L_sub=1.0000), naive additive clearcoat layering F_coat + L_sub exceeds unity at every angle: reaching 1.0700 at 60° and 1.4099 (+40.99% blowout) at 80° across all 17/17 stations.

Weidlich & Wilkie (EGSR 2007 / glTF KHR_materials_clearcoat) transmittance coupling F_coat + (1−F_coat)·L_sub partitions 60° into F=0.0700 and T=0.9300, locking E = 1.0000 across all 17 stations with 0/17 blowouts.

The 58-solid 17-station automotive clearcoat bench compares closed-form (1−F_coat) coupling against a 64-bounce Stokes internal reflection series (0.77 ms vs 11.05 ms at 8,192 passes, 14.37× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural relighting.

rounds.title_zh: 真金与紫铜侧面不再泛灰发白像镀金塑料：Gulbrandsen 复折射率金属暗边凹陷选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Gold and copper without chalky rim whitewash: Gulbrandsen complex conductor Fresnel dip selection FAQ

58 实体 17 站点金属椭偏仪台对比闭式复折射率有理式与 64 偏振角复波阻抗求积基线（8192 次 0.68 ms vs 244.10 ms，提速 361.04×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经材质生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 incident viewing angle stations (θ_i ∈ [0°, 80°] for η=0.30, κ=0.40, F0=0.3514), naive monotonic Schlick rises to 0.3716 at the 60° Pseudo-Brewster angle (+0.1216 / +48.65% chalky whitewash across 16/17 off-normal stations).

Gulbrandsen (JCGT 2014 / MaterialX artistic_ior) complex conductor Fresnel ((η−μ)²+κ²)/((η+μ)²+κ²) captures the exact Pseudo-Brewster minimum F = 0.2500 at station 12 (60°) with 0/17 whitewashed stations.

The 58-solid 17-station conductor ellipsometer bench compares closed-form rational evaluation against 64-polarization complex wave-impedance quadrature (0.68 ms vs 244.10 ms at 8,192 passes, 361.04× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural material synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 玉石与皮肤次表面散射不再糊平毛孔变成塑料蜡像：Christensen-Burley 双指数扩散选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Subsurface scattering without waxy pore blur or dead tails: Christensen-Burley dual-exponential BSSRDF selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 17 个归一化散射自由程半径站点（u=r/d ∈ [0.00, 4.00]）上，朴素单高斯次表面模糊 e^(−u²/2) 在第 4 站近心区（1d）虚胖至 0.6065 糊平毛孔，并在第 12 站（3d）暴跌至 0.0111（丢失 −0.1977 / −94.68% 深层透射长尾，污染 16/17 个站点）。

58 实体 17 站点次表面细光束密度计台对比闭式双指数与 64 偶极子多极扩散求积基线（8192 次 1.86 ms vs 124.46 ms，提速 67.09×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经皮肤生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 normalized radial stations (u=r/d ∈ [0.00, 4.00]), a naive single-Gaussian blur e^(−u²/2) bloats near-core station 4 (1d) to 0.6065 and extinguishes deep-tail station 12 (3d) to 0.0111 (−0.1977 / −94.68% tail loss across 16/17 stations).

Christensen & Burley (Pixar SIGGRAPH 2015) dual-exponential diffusion ½(e^(−u)+e^(−u/3)) preserves a crisp 0.5422 core at 1d and locks station 12 (3d) at I = 0.2088 and station 16 (4d) at 0.1410 with 0/17 corrupted stations.

The 58-solid 17-station subsurface densitometer bench compares closed-form dual-exponential evaluation against 64-dipole multipole quadrature (1.86 ms vs 124.46 ms at 8,192 passes, 67.09× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural skin synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 磨砂玻璃与冰块斜视时不再莫名发乌发黑：Walter 折射率加权粗糙折射 BTDF 选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Frosted glass without oblique darkening: Walter IOR-weighted microfacet refraction BTDF selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在空气 η_i=1.00 射入磨砂玻璃 η_o=1.50（α=0.25）跨越 17 个入射角站点（θ_i ∈ [0°, 80°]）上，朴素未加权角平分线 −normalize(V+L) 在第 12 站（60°→35.26°）产生 12.37° 法线歪斜，使透射峰值跌至 0.3194（丢失 −0.6806 / −68.06%，污染 16/17 个离轴站点）。
采用 Walter 等人 (EGSR 2007 / glTF KHR_materials_transmission) 折射率加权半向量 H_t = −normalize(η_i·V + η_o·L)，在全部 17 个视角恒定锁死斯涅尔透射峰值 I = 1.0000（0/17 饥饿站）。
58 实体 17 站点磨砂玻璃折射计台对比闭式加权半向量与 64 步微平面斯涅尔数值求根基线（8192 次 7.64 ms vs 102.97 ms，提速 13.48×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经透明抠图。
conclusions_en: Across 17 incident viewing angle stations (θ_i ∈ [0°, 80°] for η_i=1.00, η_o=1.50, α=0.25), a naive unweighted bisector −normalize(V+L) tilts by 12.37° at station 12 (60°→35.26°), starving transmission to 0.3194 (−0.6806 / −68.06% loss across 16/17 stations).

Walter et al. (EGSR 2007 / glTF KHR_materials_transmission) IOR-weighted half-vector H_t = −normalize(η_i·V + η_o·L) locks the Snell transmission peak at I = 1.0000 across all 17 stations with 0/17 starved stations.

The 58-solid 17-station frosted glass refractometer bench compares closed-form weighted half-vector evaluation against 64-step microfacet Snell root search (7.64 ms vs 102.97 ms at 8,192 passes, 13.48× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural matting.

rounds.title_zh: 实时光追粗糙地板掠射角不再爆满屏白点萤火虫：Heitz GGX 可见法线椭球采样选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Ray-traced reflections without grazing fireflies: Heitz GGX visible normal (VNDF) ellipsoid sampling selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在粗糙度 α=1.00 跨越 17 个观察视角站点（θ_v ∈ [0°, 80°]）上，朴素全 NDF 余弦采样 D(H)(N·H) 在第 12 站（60°, G1=0.6667）浪费 33.33% 背面样本并将权重膨胀至 1.5000×，在第 16 站（80°）更是飙升至 3.3794×（过冲 +237.94%，污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Heitz (JCGT 2018) 可见法线椭球采样 p_VNDF(H) = G1(V)·max(0,V·H)·D(H)/(N·V)，在全 17 个视角恒定锁死估计器权重上界 W = 1.0000×（0/17 萤火虫站）。
58 实体 17 站点 VNDF 椭球半球台对比闭式椭球投影与 64 次可见半球冠积分基线（8192 次 2.24 ms vs 21.34 ms，提速 9.51×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经降噪。
conclusions_en: Across 17 viewing angle stations (θ_v ∈ [0°, 80°] with α=1.00), naive full-NDF sampling D(H)(N·H) wastes 33.33% backfacing samples at station 12 (60°, G1=0.6667) to inflate weights to 1.5000×, and spikes to 3.3794× (+237.94%) at station 16 (80°) across 16/17 stations.
Heitz (JCGT 2018) VNDF ellipsoid sampling p_VNDF(H) = G1(V)·max(0,V·H)·D(H)/(N·V) cancels (V·H)/((N·V)·G1) to lock estimator weights at W = 1.0000× across all 17 stations with 0/17 firefly stations.

The 58-solid 17-station VNDF ellipsoid hemisphere bench compares closed-form VNDF evaluation against 64-trial visible normal cap quadrature (2.24 ms vs 21.34 ms at 8,192 passes, 9.51× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural denoising.

rounds.title_zh: 满月与粗糙陶土边缘不再像塑料台球一样变黑：Oren-Nayar V 型微槽漫反射逆反射选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Full moon and rough clay without plastic limb darkening: Oren-Nayar V-cavity rough diffuse selection FAQ

Oren & Nayar (SIGGRAPH 1994) V-cavity rough diffuse L_ON = cos θ + ⅔sin²θ locks station 12 (60°) at full-moon flatness L = 1.0000 and sustains 0.8202 at 80° with 0/17 darkened stations.

The 58-solid 17-station lunar regolith & terracotta photometer bench compares trig-free dot-product evaluation against 64-facet V-cavity masking quadrature (0.40 ms vs 108.51 ms at 8,192 passes, 273.82× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural relighting.

rounds.title_zh: 鹅卵石与浮雕砖墙侧看不再切成千层饼台阶：Tatarchuk POM 视差遮挡贴图割线求根选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Heightfield relief without pancake staircase terracing: Tatarchuk POM secant contact interpolation selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在 5 层粗粒度深度切片（Δz=0.2000m）跨越 17 个浮雕深度站点（u ∈ [0.0000, 1.0000]m）上，朴素陡峭视差（Steep Parallax）直接硬吸附离散层切片，在第 8 站（0.50m）跳变至 0.6000m（+0.1000m），在第 13 站（0.8125m）跳变至 1.0000m（+0.1875m 峰值误差，将 15/17 个内部站点切成千层饼台阶）。

58 实体 17 站点视差遮挡浮雕步进台对比 5 层 POM 一步割线求根与 64 层精细步进+二分搜索基线（8192 次 0.75 ms vs 6.00 ms，提速 8.01×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经几何生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 relief slope stations (u ∈ [0.0000, 1.0000] m with 5 coarse slices Δz=0.2000 m), naive Steep Parallax snaps to discrete layer slices: jumping to 0.6000 m (+0.1000 m) at station 8 (0.50 m) and 1.0000 m (+0.1875 m peak error) at station 13 across 15/17 terraced interior stations.
Tatarchuk (I3D 2006) POM linear secant contact interpolation w = δ_after/(δ_before+δ_after) locks station 8 at 0.5000 m and station 12 at 0.7500 m with 0.0000 m error (0/17 terraced stations).

The 58-solid 17-station POM relief raymarch bench compares 5-layer POM secant interpolation against 64-layer fine raymarching + 8-step binary refinement (0.75 ms vs 6.00 ms at 8,192 passes, 8.01× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural geometry synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 球形灯泡调大半径时地板高光不再炸成死白过曝：Karis 球面区域光 (α/α')² 能量守恒归一化选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Sphere area lights without specular energy blowout: Karis (α / α')² solid-angle normalization selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在基准粗糙度 α=0.2500 跨越 17 个球面光源半张角比站点（u = r_s/(2d) ∈ [0.0000, 0.5000]）上，朴素未归一化最近代表点法将高光面积扩大 (α'/α)² 倍却不衰减峰值，导致第 8 站（α'=0.50）总通量暴涨至 4.0000×、第 12 站（α'=0.625）暴涨至 6.2500×、第 16 站（α'=0.75）飙升至 9.0000×（污染 16/17 个站点）。

58 实体 17 站点球面区域光辐射计台对比闭式 (α/α')² 归一化与 64 环球冠斜率域数值积分基线（8192 次 0.59 ms vs 19.61 ms，提速 33.41×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经重打光。
conclusions_en: Across 17 sphere area-light subtense stations (u = r_s/(2d) ∈ [0.0000, 0.5000] with base α=0.2500), naive unnormalized closest-point lighting expands highlight area by (α'/α)² without attenuating peak intensity: exploding to 4.0000× at station 8, 6.2500× at station 12, and 9.0000× at station 16 across 16/17 blown-out stations.

rounds.title_zh: 球体与角色掠射轮廓不再炸出一圈除零白边：Lagarde-Hammon 合并 Smith 可见度函数选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 平板玻璃窗不再像实心水晶球一样扭曲窗外背景：Wyman 双界面平行板可逆折射选型 FAQ（Round 120 · 第 130 个 Demo 里程碑）

rounds.title_zh: 程序化地面网格到了远方地平线不再闪成刺眼摩尔纹：Quilez 屏幕导数 fwidth 解析盒滤波选型 FAQ（Round 125 · 第 135 个 Demo 里程碑）
rounds.title_en: Procedural 3D grids without horizon Moire strobing: Quilez analytical fwidth box-filter selection FAQ (Round 125 · 135th Demo Milestone)
conclusions_zh: 在网格线宽 T=0.25m 跨越 17 个地平线像素足迹宽度站点（w ∈ [0.25, 4.25] m）上，朴素未滤波 step() 一旦踩中细线就输出满额 1.0000，使单像素积分通量在第 3 站（1.0m）暴涨至 4.0000×、第 12 站（3.25m）暴涨至 13.0000×、第 16 站（4.25m）飙升至 17.0000×（污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Quilez (2013) & Golus 解析盒滤波覆盖率 C = T / max(T, fwidth(u))，在第 3/12/15 站衰减为 0.2500 / 0.0769 / 0.0625，全 17 站恒定锁死积分通量 Φ = 1.0000×（0/17 频闪站）。
58 实体 17 站点程序化网格解析盒滤波台对比闭式 fwidth 盒滤波与 64 抽头亚像素超采样基线（8192 次 0.75 ms vs 112.56 ms，提速 150.36×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经超分。
conclusions_en: Across 17 pixel footprint widths (w ∈ [0.25, 4.25] m for line width T=0.25 m), naive unfiltered step() outputs full 1.0000 whenever a pixel center hits the line, inflating integrated pixel flux to 4.00× at 1.0 m, 13.00× at station 12 (3.25 m), and 17.00× at 4.25 m across 16/17 Moire-strobing stations.

Quilez (2013) & Golus analytical box-filter coverage C = T / max(T, fwidth(u)) attenuates coverage to 0.2500 (4T), 0.0769 (13T), and 0.0625 (16T) to lock integrated flux at Φ = 1.0000× with 0/17 strobing stations.

The 58-solid 17-station procedural grid box-filter bench compares closed-form fwidth evaluation against 64-tap sub-pixel supersampling (0.75 ms vs 112.56 ms at 8,192 passes, 150.36× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural super-resolution.

rounds.title_zh: 屏幕空间次表面散射不再拉出十字星芒条纹：Jimenez 双通道可分离外积卷积选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Screen-space subsurface scattering without cross-shaped streaks: Jimenez 2-pass separable SSSSS outer-product selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 采用 Jimenez et al. (SIGGRAPH 2010 / 2015) 双通道可分离外积卷积（Pass 2 纵向读取 Pass 1 横向缓冲），自动生成对角象限 u²，在全 17 站恒定锁死二维总能量 E = (1−u)² + 2u(1−u) + u² = 1.0000（0/17 十字拉丝站）。
58 实体 17 站点可分离次表面外积卷积台对比双通道可分离与 64 抽头完整二维矩阵卷积基线（8192 次 0.29 ms vs 5.52 ms，提速 18.93×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经美颜模糊。
conclusions_en: Across 17 off-center blur arm weights (u ∈ [0.0000, 0.8000]), a naive single-pass + cross stencil misses all 4 diagonal quadrants u², dropping retained 2D energy to 0.7500 (−25%) at station 10 (u=0.50), 0.6400 (−36%) at station 12 (u=0.60), and 0.3600 (−64%) at station 16 (u=0.80) across 16/17 cross-streaked stations.

Jimenez et al. (SIGGRAPH 2010 / 2015) two-pass separable SSSSS chains Pass 2 onto Pass 1's output to populate diagonal quadrants u² and lock total 2D energy at E = 1.0000 across all 17 stations with 0/17 streaked stations.

The 58-solid 17-station separable SSSSS outer-product bench compares 2-pass separable evaluation against 64-tap full 2D matrix convolution (0.29 ms vs 5.52 ms at 8,192 passes, 18.93× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural skin smoothing.

rounds.title_zh: 机械剖视图与角色背光面不再死黑一团吞没描边：Gooch 冷暖有符号全向照明选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Technical cutaways without back-hemisphere shadow clipping: Gooch warm-cool signed-hemisphere shading selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 17 个有符号余弦站点（μ ∈ [+1.0000, −1.0000]）上，朴素截断朗伯漫反射 max(0, N·L) 将第 8 站（90° 明暗交界线）至第 16 站（180° 背光极点）全部 9/17 个站点截断为死黑 0.0000（抹平背光面所有倒角并吞没黑色描边线，污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Gooch et al. (SIGGRAPH 1998) & Valve Half-Lambert 有符号重映射 u = 0.5·(N·L) + 0.5（L = 0.60 + 0.40·μ），在第 8 站锁死 0.6000、第 12 站（120° 背光）保留 0.4000、第 16 站预留 0.2000 冷色底亮（0/17 死黑截断）。
58 实体 17 站点 Gooch 全向照明台对比闭式有符号重映射与 64 环球谐环境光积分基线（8192 次 0.42 ms vs 13.46 ms，提速 31.98×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经重打光。
conclusions_en: Across 17 signed cosine stations (μ ∈ [+1.0000, −1.0000]), naive clamped Lambertian max(0, N·L) clips all 9/17 stations from the 90° terminator to the 180° anti-solar pole to dead 0.0000, erasing all back-hemisphere bevels and swallowing black ink outlines.

Gooch et al. (SIGGRAPH 1998) & Valve Half-Lambert signed-hemisphere remapping u = 0.5·(N·L) + 0.5 locks the 90° terminator at 0.6000, the 120° back flank at 0.4000, and the 180° floor at 0.2000 with 0/17 clipped stations.

The 58-solid 17-station Gooch signed-hemisphere bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-ring spherical harmonic irradiance quadrature (0.42 ms vs 13.46 ms at 8,192 passes, 31.98× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural relighting.
